notes: k-ary tree deterministic constructor with `children=2` (binary). The generator emits exactly `n - 1` edges in BFS order: at each `parent` index, we push up to `children` (parent, to) pairs, increment `to` each push, and advance `parent` only after a full batch (last parent may emit fewer). Edge orientation flips on TreeMode::In ((to, parent)) and stays parent-child on TreeMode::Out and Undirected. All three modes run at ~33-57 Melem/s across n=100..1e6 (per-call cost is one `Vec::with_capacity(n-1)` allocation plus a single `Graph::add_edges` call), and throughput tracks closely with the wheel/star/ring family because the bookkeeping is identical (no RNG, no probability draws). No python-igraph oracle: `igraph_kary_tree` is deterministic so the conformance suite asserts exact edge-list equality per mode against 14 fixtures extracted from igraph C / python-igraph / rigraph. Numbers from `cargo bench --bench bench_kary_tree -- --warm-up-time 1 --measurement-time 3` on Darwin/M-series release build.
